description: M3 with improvement B done RIGHT: real heterogeneous graph (user/item/category/brand nodes) + edge-dropout two-view InfoNCE via sparse GAT. Replaces M3's feature-dropout approximation.
analysis: Improvement B done correctly per paper, but gain is marginal (+0.003). Root cause: synthetic interaction data (1509 real + 39097 popularity-weighted synthetic) lacks genuine collaborative structure for graph contrastive learning to exploit. Confirmed by cold-item collapse (HR=0.0185) and UserCF beating all learned models (0.5022) — popularity signal dominates.
